assets.name: Firestorm
assets.composition: A broad FIRESTORM FIELD: many separate short flame pillars, ember fountains and curling flame currents dispersed across the whole circular ground area, including its interior and outer reaches. The whole area ignites in a coordinated press, then burns down into embers. No single central tornado. Golden-orange cores, red-orange edge clusters, charcoal cinders. Each pillar is modest compared with the field; preserve open gaps between flames.

assets.name: Sand Storm
assets.composition: A sustained SAND STORM FIELD: many separated curling dust streamers, wind streaks, sand grains and shallow small eddies scattered through the whole circular area, including the center and outer reaches. Sandy amber, muted ochre, dark brown selective outlines. Open transparent lanes between moving dust ribbons preserve actors. No one central cyclone and no opaque dirt disc. Loop frames show local wind evolution across the entire field.

assets.name: Void Blast
assets.composition: A VOID NOVA: one expanding dark-violet energy shock front spreads outward across a circular area. Show its widening ground-level ring, thin fractured purple arcs, scattered angular void shards across the interior, and a clear maximum outer extent. A brief central flash launches the broad wave, then the wave dissipates at the perimeter. No single small starburst stamp. Transparent center after the front passes, deep violet with magenta-white clustered accents.

assets.name: Ground Slam
assets.composition: A broad GROUND SLAM: multiple branching shock cracks and low earth-and-dust eruptions spread radially outward across the FULL circular ground footprint, reaching all perimeter sectors. Sparse separated flying small stones, warm pale dust bursts, dark brown crack edges; no solid earth platform. A strong initial central strike expands into a wide shallow ground wave, then scattered fragments settle. Do not make one narrow upright rock spike.

assets.name: Earth Shock
assets.composition: An EARTH SHOCK FIELD: a widening circular ground shockwave with separated angular rocky uplift crests and branching amber-lit fissures throughout the whole footprint. Low shallow rocky arcs in several sectors, readable gaps and ground-plane perspective, soil-brown rocks with restrained amber cracks. The shock front travels from center to edge, then settles. No solid floor disc, no lone upright boulder.

assets.name: Shatter
assets.composition: A SHATTER ICE NOVA: a brittle frost ring fractures and sends MANY small sharp ice splinters radially outward across the entire circular area. Separated shallow ground frost cracks and white-blue shard splashes across the interior and outer sectors. Clear broad radial expanding wave, crisp icy facets with dark blue selective edges, no single oversized decorative snowflake. Interior becomes transparent after the burst; shards fade across the full boundary.

assets.name: Overload
assets.composition: An ELECTRICAL OVERLOAD NOVA: branching blue and golden electrical arcs erupt over a whole circular ground area, with multiple separated spark-contact sites scattered throughout the interior and perimeter. A brief central charge spreads into an interconnected broad fractured lightning web, then fades in small sparks. No single central starburst. Preserve substantial transparent gaps between narrow arcs so chibi actors remain visible.

assets.name: Aftershock
assets.composition: An AFTERSHOCK GROUND FIELD: repeated shallow concentric seismic ripple arcs and branching broken-ground cracks spread across the WHOLE circular footprint. Separate small dusty stone eruptions at many different radii and directions. Amber-lit fault lines, dark brown chunks, pale muted dust, open transparent ground between cracks. Loop frames show successive expanding ripples across the full field; no single tall glowing rock pod and no terrain platform.

assets.name: Whirlwind
assets.composition: A WHIRLWIND BLADE SWEEP: wide shallow circular silver blade crescents orbit around a small empty caster pocket, their rotating sweeps reaching the entire circular field perimeter. Several curved red-and-silver slash ribbons at different angles, sparse dust and sparks within the ring. Central pocket is approximately one 0.5m actor wide; rest of the broad field shows motion. Strong readable directional circular sweep, no tiny bracelet-sized ring, no solid colored disc.

assets.name: Venom Spray
assets.composition: A VENOM SPRAY CONE: a 90-degree fan of many SEPARATED lime-green poison droplets and short streaks spreads outward from a fixed caster origin, reaching 2.5m (five 0.5m body widths). Cover the whole fan width and depth, near, middle and far; many small splashes near the wide outer fan. Deep green selective edges, yellow-green clustered highlights. Fixed origin near lower middle local(192,290), the cone points toward the upper half of the cell. This is a cone, not a full circle, not a thin single arrow, not an opaque slime puddle.

assets.name: Cleave
assets.composition: A CLEAVE WEAPON SWEEP: a broad 120-degree silver steel slash fan extending 2.1m (4.2 actor body widths) outward from a fixed caster origin near lower middle local(192,290), opening toward the upper half of the cell. Show a sweeping crescent moving across the full sector from one side to the other, with short pale-gold contact sparks spread along its travel. Crisp dark steel selective edges, off-white highlights, sparse separated motion ribbons. Preserve the caster pocket and empty outside-cone ground. Not a full ring, not a straight thin line, not one small target starburst.
